title: Streamlining Trauma Research Evaluation With Advanced Measurement
brief_summary: The STREAM Study is a prospective longitudinal observational outcomes study that will examine the reliability, validity and responsiveness of the PROMIS tools for clinical research following orthopaedic trauma.
raw_criteria: Any patient participating in the FIXIT, OUTLET, TAOS, OXYGEN, VANCO or Pain studies returning for a 3 month follow-up visit is eligible for participation in the proposed STREAM study. Respondents who are unable to give informed consent (or would require a proxy) at the time of the 3 month visit will be excluded.
study_population: Orthopaedic trauma patients who are currently enrolled in the PAIN, FIXIT, OUTLET, OXYGEN, VANCO or TAOS METRC studies. These studies look at outcomes following injuries to the foot, ankle, tibia etc.
